title: 小晶片互連實體層
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入晶粒間 PHY 通道、時序、訓練及量測；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine die-to-die phy channels, timing, training and measurement. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。UCIe 是含多層的規範體系；本文教學算例不代表任何版次的強制速率、編碼或時序限制，互通性須依指定版次測試。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. UCIe spans multiple layers; examples are not mandated rates, coding or timing limits of any version. Interoperability needs version-specific compliance testing.

stages.title: 實體與協定
stages.description: 本階段處理實體與協定：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address phy and protocol through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 分離 PHY 與協定
steps.titleEn: Separate PHY and protocol
steps.objective: 建立「分離 PHY 與協定」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：電氣傳輸、連結管理與上層資料語義處於不同層。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for separate phy and protocol: Electrical transport, link management and data semantics occupy different layers.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫出資料由協定到焊墊的邊界。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw boundaries from protocol to pads. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫出資料由協定到焊墊的邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw boundaries from protocol to pads. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：支援相同協定就保證電氣互通。本步先檢查「分離 PHY 與協定」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到電氣傳輸、連結管理與上層資料語義處於不同層。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: The same protocol guarantees electrical interoperability. First check whether evidence for separate phy and protocol actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Electrical transport, link management and data semantics occupy different layers.
steps.check: 交付「分離 PHY 與協定」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for separate phy and protocol, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.text: 重算 102.4 GB/s 並保留位元位元組換算。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate 102.4 GB/s with explicit bit/byte conversion. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

knowledge.title: 自訂算例與模型界限
knowledge.titleEn: Hypothetical worked example and model boundary
knowledge.text: 假設 64 條資料線、每線 16 Gb/s、有效負載效率 80%，有效單向頻寬為 64×16×0.8/8=102.4 GB/s。線上速率不是應用有效吞吐。 UCIe 是含多層的規範體系；本文教學算例不代表任何版次的強制速率、編碼或時序限制，互通性須依指定版次測試。
knowledge.textEn: For 64 data lanes at 16 Gb/s and 80% payload efficiency, useful one-way bandwidth is 102.4 GB/s. Line rate is not application throughput. UCIe spans multiple layers; examples are not mandated rates, coding or timing limits of any version. Interoperability needs version-specific compliance testing.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for calculate useful throughput: challenge and acceptance?

GB/s 與 Gb/s 可直接混用
optionsEn: Recalculate 102.4 GB/s with explicit bit/byte conversion.
The same protocol guarantees electrical interoperability
quiz.explanation: 通道數乘線速率還需扣除協定和流量控制開銷。 重算 102.4 GB/s 並保留位元位元組換算。
quiz.explanationEn: Lane count times rate still needs protocol and flow-control overhead. Recalculate 102.4 GB/s with explicit bit/byte conversion.
